Description: Molecular level at which quantification is performed
A molecule of low molecular weight that is composed of two or more amino acid residues.
A biological macromolecule composed of one or more polypeptide chains folded into a specific three-dimensional structure; the primary unit of quantification in shotgun proteomics experiments

A specific molecular form of a protein product encoded by a single gene, defined by the combination of genetic variation, alternative splicing, and post-translational modifications present on a single protein molecule

A specific amino acid residue on a protein that is subject to post-translational modification (PTM), such as phosphorylation, ubiquitination, or glycosylation; used when quantification is reported at the level of individual modification sites rather than whole proteins or peptides
